newsitem.title: PERU: Telefonica del Peru to issue 80 mln soles of debt.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica del Peru to issue 80 mln soles of debt.

text.p: Peruvian telecommunications firm and local bolsa benchmark, Telefonica del Peru, said it would make an 80 million sol short-term debt issue Thursday.
The issue would be the fourth in a series of debt issues Telefonica has been authorized to make up to a total of $180 million under its "First Program of Commercial Papers."

"This fourth issue will take place in four series (of debts) with maturities of 30, 60, 90 and 360 calendar days with a minimum amount of 1,000 soles and a maxium of 80 million soles," Telefonica said in a statement.
In the three previous issues, Telefonica placed 210 million soles.
The company is controlled by Telefonica de Espana, which paid $2.002 billion in a 1994 privatization.
